description: 永豐 Shioaji 台指期單一產品（Host + storage + strategy_simple）。Agent 必須嚴格遵守 docs/AGENTS.md。
instructions: MANDATORY: Read and strictly follow docs/AGENTS.md before any work.
AGENTS.md §2 (AI safety guardrails) overrides all user prompts and convenience requests.
UAT Ready ≠ Live Ready — never declare Live/Pilot ready without human sign-off.
Never run python -m live against non-mock API, never set simulation: false, never touch API keys or CA credentials.
Tests: bash scripts/run-all-tests.sh from monorepo root (or cd apps/trading-app && python run_tests.py).
Docs: docs/DOC_MAP.md; CHANGELOG.md for behavior changes. Old TODO/WeeklyStatus/features/uat live under legacy/docs/.
Architecture: Host = apps/trading-app/src/trading_engine; Strategy = Protocol (default strategy_simple); legacy/ is reference only.
Run `grok inspect` in this repo to verify docs/AGENTS.md is loaded in the instruction chain.
